title: ID0379375-DC/Si-D/SE [MP / S3 170003435] Timeout P01 --> P02
description:
Reported behavior
/
issue:
We only have 90 seconds between P01 --> P02 then we go to P00. Is there a reason for this?
I think this is a big reason why we have a lot of failed charging attempts. Especially when using an external payment kiosk.
I have tested some other chargers and they have the following times.
ABB Terra has 2 minutes.
Tesla has 2 minutes.
Alpitronic hypercharger has 4 minutes.
I think we should increase the timeout to at least 3 minutes, preferably 5 minutes.
One other thing is also that for this charger we have not selected any  authorization option because it uses a external payment kiosk.
This means when the customer selects an outlet on the screen then they will see an empty screen and this causes confusion.
Root cause:  R&D ticket created
Solution: Update on a future FW version. As of now it's on R&D side - No need for Support tikcet.
Issue reported on Ecog on ticket
SASW-1562 (*Parallel topic)
parameter “performanceTimeout” has the new default value 5 minutes
planned in 1.6.0 scope (SiD v6.2.0)
Created Jira Ticket EVC3-7066 requesting to display a message when no authorization method is selected on SCB.
